title: Nonobench: an open benchmark of 49 LLMs on nonogram puzzles, public and open source [P]
summary: Nonobench measures how well LLMs solve nonograms (picross). Each model gets the row and column clues once and returns the full grid. No tools, one attempt per puzzle. Method: - Standard mode: 30 puzzles from 5x5 to 15x15 (from the Nonograms dataset by Moyà-Alcover, CC BY 4.0). -
